query: We're building a corporate website with about 30 pages. I need help planning the content model — which sections should be singles vs channels vs structures, and how should I handle the team page where each member has a bio, photo, role, and social links?

I want to add a Matrix field to our blog posts for flexible content — text blocks, image galleries, pull quotes, and embedded videos. How should I configure the entry types and what view mode works best for editors?
We need to migrate our existing category groups to entries before upgrading to Craft 6. We have 'Topics' (hierarchical, ~50 items) and 'Tags' (flat, ~200 items). What's the entrification process?

I'm trying to set up eager loading for a listing page that shows entries with their hero image, category, and author. I keep getting N+1 queries even though I'm using .with(). The template loops through entries and accesses entry.heroImage.one(), entry.topics.all(), and entry.author
What field type should I use for a color picker that lets editors choose from our 6 brand colors? I don't want them entering arbitrary hex values, just selecting from predefined options

We need to plan a multi-language site with English and French. How does propagation work for entries — can some fields be translated while others stay the same across sites? And what happens with Matrix blocks?
I want to add a 'relatedArticles' field to our blog entry type. Should I use an Entries field with sources limited to the blog section, or is there a better pattern for manual content curation?

Help me decide between CKEditor with nested entries vs Matrix for a page builder. Our editors want to write flowing text with occasional callouts, image blocks, and CTAs mixed in — not a strict block-by-block layout
I need to build a Twig component for rendering cards with different layouts — image on top, horizontal, and text-only. Using atomic design pattern with extends/block
How do I configure the Vite dev server to work with DDEV and hot module replacement? I keep getting connection refused errors
I'm writing a custom field type plugin that stores JSON data and renders a custom input in the CP. How do I extend craft\base\Field and register it?
Can you set up a GitHub Actions workflow that runs ECS and PHPStan on pull requests for our Craft plugin?
We need to add custom permissions to our Craft plugin so that only editors in the 'Content Managers' group can access our plugin's CP section
Help me optimize our Craft site for Core Web Vitals — our LCP is 4.2 seconds and CLS is 0.15. Most of the delay seems to be from images loading above the fold

I need to plan the field layout for our 'Event' entry type. Each event has a date range (start and end), a venue (related entry from Venues section), a ticket price with currency, capacity, and a registration URL. Some of these feel like they might collide with reserved handles
Should I use globals or singles for site-wide settings like footer content, social media links, and the company address? We're starting a new Craft 5 project
